identity.notes: The ledger identifier and packet locationId say Washington, DC, but the restaurant-controlled homepage, its map link, and the exact restaurant-linked Toast store all independently identify the sole verified business at 130 N Washington St, Falls Church, Virginia. The result preserves that evidenced Falls Church scope instead of forcing the ledger label.

sources.excerpt: The restaurant-controlled homepage identifies Clare and Don's Beach Shack at 130 North Washington Street, Falls Church, VA 22046; it links the official dine-in menu, catering menu, weekly Sunday brunch, and the exact Toast ordering store.
The location map linked by the official site targets 130 N Washington St, Falls Church, VA 22046.
The current official Menu page links two location-wide menu image panels published under the restaurant's own domain.
The visually reviewed front menu panel covers beverages, desserts, sides, children's meals, and starters, with item descriptions and dietary symbols.

The visually reviewed back menu panel covers soups, salads, cantina items, combinations, pasta and rice, grill items, burgers, sandwiches, and baskets; its legend states vegan optional, vegetarian, and gluten free upon request.
The current official Catering page links one on-premise crowd-pleasers panel dated March 2026 and two off-premise panels dated January 2025.
The visually reviewed current Crowd Pleasers menu lists vegetarian and mixed appetizer packages for parties of at least 20.
The visually reviewed current Buy the Dozens menu lists savory platters, seafood, sliders, skewers, desserts, and add-on trays.
The visually reviewed current Dinner All the Way menu lists five complete catered meal packages.
The official site advertises Sunday brunch every week from 9:30 AM to 1 PM and lists Omelet Bar, Waffles, Huevos Rancheros, Home Fries, Pastries, and Fresh Fruit.

The exact restaurant-linked Toast store identifies 130 N Washington St, Falls Church, VA 22046 and exposes current food, dessert, side, and nonalcoholic drink categories plus item descriptions and customization advisories.
The location-specific Toast menu exposes the scheduled Sunday brunch presentation, including the Omelet Bar and Fresh Squeezed Juice.

Official-domain document search surfaced this 2021 catering PDF, but the live Catering page now points to newer 2025 and 2026 menu images; the older PDF is retained only as a non-current document-search record.

Fresh targeted searches reconfirmed the official Falls Church pages, menu images, exact Toast store, scheduled brunch, and an archived catering PDF. No restaurant-issued comprehensive allergen matrix or facility cross-contact statement was found.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The official main menu legend identifies vegan-optional, vegetarian, and gluten-free-upon-request presentations.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: These are dietary or modification signals, not a comprehensive allergen matrix. Gluten-free-upon-request is not converted into a categorical wheat or gluten absence claim.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Toast item customization warns that the restaurant will try to accommodate special requests but may not be able to honor all substitutions.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is an accommodation limitation, not a product-level allergen guarantee or an explicit facility cross-contact statement.

findings.summary: The verified restaurant is in Falls Church, Virginia at 130 N Washington St. The Washington, DC ledger label is a location metadata error; no Washington restaurant location was merged into this record.

The current physical-location catalog is the consolidated union of 20 complete official and restaurant-linked dine-in, weekly brunch, catering, online-ordering, and nonalcoholic-drink surfaces, totaling 199 unique products after equivalent presentation collapse.

Eight frozen rows are not current POC food or nonalcoholic products: six site/event/navigation cards, one Toast category heading, and the alcoholic Robbie's Mango Tea cocktail. They are reconciled as artifacts with no current-product mappings.

The frozen projection omitted current weekly brunch, three current catering panels, many Toast products and sides, and current nonalcoholic drinks. Those restaurant-specific surfaces are now represented directly without importing Lazy Mike's as a separate restaurant catalog.

No comprehensive official allergen matrix was found after all four required searches. Product positives come only from literal official or linked-vendor ingredients; all remaining allergen status is accurately unavailable.

Vegan-optional, vegetarian, gluten-free-upon-request, and substitution controls are preserved as contextual evidence only. They do not prove categorical allergen absence or eliminate cross-contact risk.

proposedChanges: Correct this record's published location scope from the misleading Washington label to the evidenced Falls Church, Virginia address without merging another business.
Replace the 98-row under-extracted and artifact-contaminated projection with the 199-product union of current dine-in, weekly brunch, catering, Toast, side, dessert, and nonalcoholic drink surfaces.
Collapse repeated Featured, side-onion-ring, and equivalent Fresh Catch presentations while retaining every supporting surface reference.
Remove event, navigation, category-heading, Lazy Mike's, and alcoholic-product artifacts from the food/nonalcoholic catalog.
Preserve literal ingredient positives, the dietary legend, and the Toast accommodation advisory while marking unsupported allergen absence and facility cross-contact details unavailable.
